path.label: Learning path
path.uniNote: {faculty}, {program} (bachelor's, 1st cycle). Courses and topics follow the public curriculum ({year}); languages, internships and the thesis are not included.
path.curriculumNote: Learning content (topics, tasks, textbook) currently follows the Slovenian curriculum and is in Slovenian. The tutor explains it to you in your language.
daily.title: Today's workout
daily.about: About 15 minutes: new material and review
daily.doneText: Done for today. You can do one more round.
daily.text: About 15 minutes: new material and a little review.
path.allDone: All topics on this path are mastered!
path.allDoneToast: All topics on this path are mastered. Pick another path or review.
path.levelNow: Your learning path is now set to {level}.
level.title: Difficulty
unit.label: Unit {n}
unit.lockedNote: Unlocks when you master the previous unit.
suggest.title: 5 minutes of review first?
suggest.text: You have {n} tasks waiting for review. A short review keeps what you've learned from fading. Or you can go straight on to new material.
test.howto: Each day, solve a set of mixed tasks from these units. The closer the test, the harder the tasks.
test.which: What will be on the test?
topic.noExplanation: The explanation for this topic isn't ready yet. The tutor will first ask what you already know, then explain step by step.
topic.noExplanationShort: The explanation for this topic isn't ready yet.
topic.confirmKnown: Do you really know this topic? It will be marked as mastered and will show up in review.
task.loadError: I couldn't load the task ({msg}). Check your connection and try again.
task.writeTitle: Input with finger or mouse: keypad or handwriting
task.checkError: I couldn't check your answer ({msg}). Check your connection and try again.
task.harder: The next tasks will be a bit harder.
task.easier: The next tasks will be a bit easier so you can strengthen the basics.
task.mastered: Topic mastered! I'll invite you to review it tomorrow.
task.workPh: Write your steps here, like in your notebook …

task.attemptsLeft.one: {n} more attempt, then I'll show a worked example.
task.attemptsLeft.other: {n} more attempts, then I'll show a worked example.

task.tapPoint: Tap an orange point to see its coordinates.
task.graphAria: Graph of a line in a coordinate system
task.lineAria: Number line with the solution marked
placement.unlocked: The unit is unlocked for learning; start with the first topic.
result.firstTry: Correct on the first try: {correct} of {total}
session.reviewIntro: Mixed tasks from topics that are due for review, so the knowledge sticks.
session.reviewEmpty: Nothing to review right now. Review tasks appear a few days after new material.
session.placementIntro: No hints. With at least 80% the unit unlocks and counts as mastered.
session.dailyIntro: About 15 minutes: new material with review in between.
session.dailyEmpty: There are no workout tasks on this path yet. Start with new material.
session.unitIntro: Interleaved tasks from all topics in this unit.
session.testPrepIntro: Mixed tasks from the test material. The closer the test, the harder they get.
session.tekIntro: Interleaved harder tasks from all competition topics. Hints and solutions are available as in practice.
session.contestIntro: One attempt per task, no hints. You see your points at the end.
comp.title: Competitions
comp.intro: Only harder, competition-style tasks: {list}. The app builds tasks modelled on competition problems, so they are not copies of past competitions.
comp.trainText: Ten interleaved tasks from all topics, with hints and solutions.
comp.contestText: {tasks} tasks, {minutes} minutes, one attempt per task and no hints. 3, 4 or 5 points depending on difficulty (max {max}).
comp.historyEmpty: Your mock competition results will appear here.
comp.topicsSaved: Your topics and difficulty are saved just like on the learning path.
comp.topicsFree: Pick a topic and practise just that. Units are not locked, you can start anywhere.
comp.timerNote: Answers are saved; you see your points at the end.
comp.confirmSkip: Skip this task? You can't go back, and it won't earn points.
comp.confirmFinish: Really finish the competition? Unanswered tasks earn no points.
comp.good: Good! Look at the solutions to the tasks you missed.
comp.hard: Competition tasks are hard. Go through the solutions and practise the topics that gave you trouble.
comp.notReached: You didn't get to this task.
chat.photo: Take a photo of the task
chat.placeholder: Type a task or a question …
chat.hint: You can photograph the task, say it (microphone) or type it with symbols (Σ). You can also write "now chemistry".
chat.intro: Type a task or take a photo of it. We'll solve it together step by step.
chat.tapToSkip: Tap to show the whole answer
chat.deeperMsg: I don't really understand this. Explain it in more detail, step by step.
set.title: Settings
set.name: Name
set.schoolNote: The learning path, tasks and textbook adapt to your choice. For university they follow the programme's public curriculum.
set.subject: Subject
set.paceNote: How fast the tutor's text appears. Tapping a message shows it all at once.
set.finishSchool: Finish choosing your school and year.
set.helpText: A short tour shows where everything is in the app.
set.deleteStudent: Delete this student and all their conversations
set.confirmDelete: Really delete student {name} and all their conversations?
lang.title: Language
lang.label: App and tutor language
lang.note: The tutor answers in the language you choose. The interface is translated into {n} languages; for the others it uses the closest language available.
prog.title: Progress
prog.weakNote: Detected automatically from conversations (at least 3 turns, at least 40% errors in the last 60 days) and entered manually. STEMMind takes them into account when explaining.
prog.subject: Subject
prog.flagsNote: Conversations where STEMMind detected distress, a dangerous request or an attempt to get around the rules.
me.settingsSub: Profile, school, language, look and colours
onb.text: Tell us where you study and we'll tailor the learning path, tasks and textbook. You can change it any time in your profile.
onb.name: Name or nickname
onb.finish: Finish choosing your school and year.
tour.dailyText: About 15 minutes every day. The app mixes new material and review for you.
tour.pathText: Topics follow the curriculum. The next unit unlocks when you master the previous one. Tap a topic to start.
tour.modesText: Switch between new material, review and test prep at any time. Your progress is kept.
tour.meText: Your progress, leagues and settings are here, including the app's language, look and colours.
tour.chatText: When you get stuck, ask the tutor. It guides you step by step instead of just giving you the answer.
ap.title: Appearance
ap.note: Colours apply to this device. Text always stays easy to read: if a chosen colour doesn't have enough contrast, the app darkens or lightens it a little.
ap.textDarker: The chosen text colour was hard to read on this background, so it has been darkened a little.
ap.textLighter: The chosen text colour was hard to read on this background, so it has been lightened a little.
me.feedbackSub: Tell us what's good and what isn't
fb.cardText: Take two minutes to tell us what's good and what isn't. We'll improve the app based on your suggestions.
fb.intro: You're helping us make STEMMind better. Everything is optional, fill in what you like.
fb.ratingsHint: 1 = bad, 5 = great. Leave empty what you didn't try.
fb.bad: What bothered you or didn't work?
fb.badPh: e.g. a button doesn't respond on my phone
fb.ideas: What would you add or change?
fb.recommend: Would you recommend STEMMind to a friend?
fb.name: Name (optional)
fb.thanks: Thank you! Your feedback has been saved.
fb.thanksText: Once we've collected the feedback, we'll improve the app.
fb.chatIntro: The tutor will ask you a few short questions. Answer in your own words.
fb.q.used: Hi! What did you try first or use most in STEMMind?
fb.q.liked: What did you like about it, and why?
fb.q.stuck: Where did you get stuck, what confused you or what didn't work?
fb.q.where: Which screen was that on, and what were you doing at the time?
fb.q.change: If you were in charge, what would you change or add in the app?
fb.q.use: Would you use STEMMind for school? Why or why not?
fb.q.done: Thanks, that helps us a lot! I've saved your answers.
fb.adminNote: Only visible on the computer where STEMMind is running.
path.regionNote: Your learning path follows {system} (draft). Practice tasks and lessons still come from the Slovenian material; the tutor explains everything in your language.
set.dataAuto: Automatic (on slow connections or with data saver)
set.dataNote: Shorter tutor replies, smaller photos, no animations and no extra font. Tasks for your learning path are saved so you can practise offline.
off.banner: You're offline. You can practise tasks saved on this device ({n}).
off.bannerEmpty: You're offline. Once you're back online, practice tasks will be saved to this device.
off.pending: Answers from offline practice are waiting to be sent ({n}).
usage.summary: Active students: {active} · average {avg} € per student · {msg} € per reply · estimate for the whole month: {proj} €
usage.saved: Replies without an AI call (reused answers and practice hints): {count}
usage.limits: Limits per student: {deep}× detailed explanation per day; above {soft} $ a month a faster model; above {hard} $ a month practice only.
exam.title: Exam preparation
exam.trainText: Ten mixed tasks from the exam topics, with hints and solutions. The difficulty adapts to you.
exam.mockText: {tasks} questions ({choice} multiple choice), {minutes} minutes, one attempt and no hints. Up to {max} marks.
exam.scaleNote: Your result is converted to the exam scale {min}–{max} (approximately).
exam.historyEmpty: Results of your mock exams will appear here.
exam.topicsNote: Pick a topic and practise just that. Exam questions are in English; the tutor explains them in your language.
exam.confirmFinish: Finish the exam now? Unanswered questions score no marks.
exam.scaled: Score on the exam scale: about {value} ({min}–{max})
exam.good: Good! Look at the solutions of the questions you missed.
exam.hard: Review the solutions and practise the topics where you lost marks.
exam.mockIntro: Questions in the exam format, timed, one attempt and no hints. You see your marks at the end.
refs.title: Reference material
refs.intro: Free textbooks, lecture notes, videos and problem sets for the courses in your programme. Links lead to the official sites of publishers, universities and faculties.
refs.none: No sources collected for this course yet.
exam.gradeNote: At the end you also get an approximate grade on the exam's scale.
chk.number: Enter a number (a decimal point or comma both work).
chk.addUnit: The number is there, now add the unit. What unit is the result in?
chk.unit: Check the unit: write the result in {unit}.
chk.rounding: Your calculation is right, only the rounding is off. Correctly rounded, it is {right}.
chk.fraction: Write a fraction as a/b (e.g. 3/4) or a mixed number (e.g. 1 1/2).
chk.simplify: The value is right, but simplify the fraction fully.
chk.coef: Enter {n} whole numbers separated by commas (write a coefficient of 1 too).
chk.coefMin: The equation is balanced, but the coefficients must be the smallest possible whole numbers.
chk.tryAgain: Not right yet. Look at the hint and try again. Where did you get stuck?
chk.example: Let's look at a worked example, then you try a similar task.
pad.label: Answer input
pad.drawNote: Write as you go, like in a notebook. Write the final answer on the last line, then press {check}.
pad.emptyDraw: First write your answer on the lines below.
pad.readFail: I couldn't read the handwriting. Try writing bigger or use the keys.
me.graphSub: Function graphs, curves, sliders and tables
gc.title: Graphing calculator
gc.help: Type a function, equation, inequality or point, e.g. y = x², x² + y² = 9, y > 2x, (2, 3) or r = sin(4θ). Tap a curve to see zeros, extrema and intersections.
gc.errNeedEq: Add an equals sign, e.g. x² + y² = 9.
gc.errOnlyY: Write a curve that depends on y as x = …
gc.errSyntax: The expression is unfinished or I don't understand it.
gc.label: Show coordinates
gc.noGraphs: You have no saved graphs yet.
gc.offline: Saved graphs are available when you are online.
gc.ask: Ask the tutor about this graph
task.hintData: First write down what is given and what you are looking for.
chk.sign: The size is right but the sign is not. Check whether the result is positive or negative.
chk.magnitudeBig: The digits are right but the order of magnitude is not: the result is {times} times too big. Check the unit conversion and the decimal point.
chk.magnitudeSmall: The digits are right but the order of magnitude is not: the result is {times} times too small. Check the unit conversion and the decimal point.
chk.reciprocal: You got the reciprocal. Did you divide in the wrong order?
chk.factor2Big: The result is exactly 2 times too big. Check whether you left out or added a factor of 2 (e.g. ½ in the formula, diameter instead of radius).
chk.factor2Small: The result is exactly 2 times too small. Check whether you left out or added a factor of 2 (e.g. ½ in the formula, diameter instead of radius).
sc.meSub: Scientific and graphing calculator, units, periodic table, formulas
sc.title: Scientific calculator
sc.empty: Type a calculation, e.g. 2·sin(30°) + √16, and press =. The result is also stored in Ans.
sc.errEquation: This is an equation or inequality. To graph it choose Graphing, to solve it Tools → Equations.
sc.errUndefined: The result is undefined (e.g. division by 0).
sc.c.Vm: Molar volume of a gas (0 °C, 101.3 kPa)
sc.dataHint: Separate numbers with spaces, semicolons or new lines. A decimal comma is allowed.
sc.eq.sysHint: Each row is one equation: coefficients of the unknowns, the last field is the right-hand side.
sc.eq.leadZero: The leading coefficient must not be 0.
sc.eq.many: The system has infinitely many solutions.
sc.cx.hint: Use i for the imaginary unit, e.g. (2 + 3i)(1 − i), sqrt(−4) or polar form 2∠30°.
sc.mx.hint: Write each matrix row on its own line, separate numbers with spaces.
sc.mx.size: The matrix sizes do not match for this operation.
sc.mx.singular: The matrix has no inverse (its determinant is 0).
sc.base.invalid: The number has a digit that this base does not have.
sc.badElement: Unknown element “{sym}”. Mind upper and lower case (Co is cobalt, CO is carbon monoxide).
sc.badFormula: The formula is not written correctly (check the brackets).
sc.formNone: There is no formula sheet for this subject yet.
inst.title: STEMMind as an app
inst.text: Add STEMMind to your home screen: it opens with one tap, full screen, and even offline.
inst.textDesk: Install STEMMind on your computer: it opens in its own window, even offline.
inst.meSub: An icon on your phone's home screen
inst.ios1: Tap the “Share” button (a square with an arrow pointing up) in the browser bar.
inst.ios2: Scroll down and choose “Add to Home Screen”.
inst.ios3: Tap “Add” in the top right. STEMMind is now with your apps.
inst.iosNote: The first time you open the app, you may need to sign in again.
inst.inApp: This page is open inside another app. Open it in your browser (menu ⋯ or ⋮ → “Open in browser”) and add it to your home screen there.
inst.and1: Tap the browser menu ⋮ (three dots in the top right).
inst.and2: Choose “Install app” or “Add to Home screen” and confirm.
inst.desk1: In the browser menu choose “Install STEMMind” (in Safari: File → Add to Dock).
inst.done: STEMMind is installed. You'll find it on your home screen.
inst.desc: Tutor for maths, physics and chemistry
sc.bond.title: Bond between two elements
sc.bond.note: The limits 0.4 and 1.7 are approximate: bond character changes gradually.
sc.bond.metalNote: Two metals form a metallic bond or an alloy.
sc.rxn.hint: E.g. Fe + O2 -> Fe2O3. Write charges with ^, e.g. SO4^2- or Fe^3+, and an electron as e-.
sc.rxn.arrow: Put an arrow -> between reactants and products.
sc.rxn.none: This equation cannot be balanced. Check the formulas.
sc.rxn.many: The equation can be balanced in several ways (several reactions at once). Write each reaction separately.
sc.rxn.stoichHint: Enter the mass or amount of one substance (or of several reactants to find the limiting reactant).
sc.ph.hint: Enter one value; the others are calculated.
sc.acid.noteSa: A strong acid ionises completely in water: [H₃O⁺] = z · c.
sc.acid.noteSb: A strong base dissociates completely in water: [OH⁻] = z · c.
sc.acid.noteW: A weak acid or base ionises only partly; we use the constant Ka or Kb.
sc.cn.hint: Enter what you know (at least two quantities); the rest is calculated.
sc.cn.bad: The value entered is not a number.
sc.dil.hint: Enter three quantities; the fourth is calculated. Both volumes use the same unit.
sc.w.hint: Enter two quantities; the other two are calculated.
sc.sol.title: Solubility of salts and hydroxides in water
sc.sol.x: does not exist or decomposes in water
sc.sol.note: At room temperature. Soluble: more than 1 g per 100 g of water, slightly soluble: 0.01 to 1 g, insoluble: less than 0.01 g. Tap a cell.
sc.prob.k.inv: x such that P(X ≤ x) = p
sc.prob.badParams: The distribution parameters are not valid.
sc.prob.badP: The probability p must be between 0 and 1.
sc.prob.chart: Distribution graph with the probability shaded
sc.ana.rootsHint: Roots are searched on the interval [a, b].
sc.ana.badInterval: The bounds are not valid (the lower must be smaller than the upper).
sc.ana.noRoots: There are no roots on this interval.
sc.ana.intDiverge: The integral does not exist (the function is unbounded on the interval).
sc.ana.numNote: The limit is estimated numerically; check it by calculation too.
sc.ana.noTaylor: The function is not differentiable at this point.
sc.vec.hint: Separate components with a comma and a space or with a semicolon, e.g. 2, 1, 3.
sc.vec.dim: The vectors must have the same number of components.
sc.ode.hint: E.g. y' = y, y' = x − y, y'' = −y. The solution is numerical.
sc.ode.blowup: The solution goes to infinity at x = {x}.
sc.err.propHint: E.g. 2π·sqrt(l/g) or m/V. For each quantity enter its value and absolute error.
sc.err.fill: Enter the values and errors of all quantities.
sc.p3.aria: 3D surface graph; rotate it with the arrow keys, zoom with + and −
sc.p3.hint: Drag to rotate; zoom with the wheel or two fingers. Colour shows the height z.
cards.title: Review flashcards
cards.intro: Key facts from the tutor's explanations. First try to recall the answer yourself, then check it. Cards you know come back less and less often.
cards.empty: You have no flashcards yet. The tutor adds them when it explains an important fact. You can also add your own.
cards.keys: Keys: space = show answer, 1 = don't know yet, 2 = I know it
games.intro: Play and calculate: {n} games from arithmetic to calculus. The difficulty adapts to you.
games.search: Search for a game or topic
games.e.meteor.how: The meteors carry answers. Tap the meteor with the correct answer before it hits the shield. Keys: 1–4 or ← → and space.
games.e.balloons.how: Pop the balloon with the correct answer before time runs out. A wrong balloon costs a life. Keys: ← → and space.
games.e.runner.how: Tap a lane or swipe left and right (keys ← →) to run through the gate with the correct answer.
games.e.sorter.how: Is the statement on the crate true? Tap ✓ or ✗ (keys → and ←) before the crate leaves the belt.
